runs.notes: Fourteen research workers: cards Q136-Q149 (illustrators and image models; the IPS as precommitment in its builders' words; what a late Treasury payment looks like; pledges that go unpaid; why residencies close; binding records in ink far from comics; Taiwan funders' budget calendars; near misses and learning; bill ETFs for waiting money; Taiwan's own arts-building overruns; data freshness, which found Fidelity International's 7.6% and moved the median of published forecasts; how gift offices count a figure; artists' receipts in official data; disagreement in small teams), 534 rows (each card's Gaps says what was read only in part); fourteen raters judged every row the same evening (store 7,841 ideas); eight analysis workers (numbers owner twice: four register slips fixed, the 13 Nov curve range and an early end of the late-2032 fund, NUMBERS sections 3 and 4; exhibits second and third passes; the aha test 7 pack and its results; landing Q136-Q149 in SKELETON, CONCEIT, GEM_LEDGER section 14, REFERENCES 2j and CANON B12-B14; the readers' fixes) and two fresh voice writers; nine readers: voice round 9 (three), cold aha test 7 (three), coherence reader 10, a lay reader and bond desk 5

Twelve research workers: cards Q151-Q162 (bond ETFs that end early or merge; bought deals and firm commitments; dividend policy, Lintner's managers and specials; quasi-option value and staged commitment; subjects, holds and pencilled dates in trades far from comics; what a Taiwan residency costs to run each year; certainty of subject matter and security entitlements; how far an arts nonprofit's running money swings; a range against one figure; deferred pay funded when promised; Taiwan's life insurers and a strong Taiwan dollar; defined-outcome funds as the design the plan refuses), 485 rows (each card's Gaps says what was read only in part); five synthesis workers built 37 syntheses from five clusters of the store's tags (29 kept or adapted, `research/SYNTHESES.md`, card Q150's 28 rows); thirteen raters judged every row of Q150-Q162 the same morning (513 rows: 317 keep, 123 adapt, 73 merged, 0 refuse; store 8,354 ideas); four analysis workers (numbers owner: labels and the one-fund wording, NUMBERS 8w on one fund behind three promises; SKELETON landing and panel 4's fixes; CONCEIT V2.2, GEM_LEDGER and references) and two fresh voice writers; nine readers: panel 4 (three judges), voice round 10 (three), cold aha test 8 (three, eight syntheses and the control)

Book 21 and Book 22. Twelve research workers on big ideas from far fields (cards Q163-Q174: literature of bonds and promises; the philosophy of promising; precommitment; the history of reserves; the gift; what certain means; Damodaran and Shiller read whole; the economics of artists; why buildings overrun; defeasance and the ledger; pencil and ink facts), 388 rows; a thirteenth on the copout (card Q175, from theory and wide reading); two on the prior art of sentences that make sense and of erudite but clear prose; six raters judged every row the same evening (239 keep, 69 adapt, 76 merged, 4 refuse; store 8,742 ideas); analysis: the writers' fact sheet rebuilt as facts only (version 2) and Keel's analysis of why version 61 could not be followed (voice/WHY_V61_FAILED.md); sixteen blind readers in comprehension study 1 (563 sentences, calibrated against Caplet's list); the overdrive plan to 27 Nov (OVERDRIVE_PLAN.md)

Twelve research workers took tonight's strongest rows one level deeper, each reading its source whole (cards Q176-Q187: the law of lateness behind Antonio; the Opera House Act's cost clause; Osaka's rice bills and their court; Franklin's and Carnegie's bequests; Pliny's letters on Bithynia's cities; the patent rule that each part does its own duty; Savage's small worlds; the Fixed-term Parliaments Act bypassed; Athens's reserve; Lejeune's pact; when accounting counts a debt settled; Hirschman's Hiding Hand), 334 rows; six raters judged every row of Q175-Q187 the same night (deeper rows: 196 keep, 36 adapt, 102 merged); 25 parent rows corrected at source (Carnegie in Boston and the Osaka guarantee overturned, the Opera House narrowed, five of six aha test 9 candidates changed; GEM_LEDGER 16a); one landing worker (SKELETON notes per part, GEM_LEDGER 16, AHA_REGISTER, REFERENCES); store 9,110 ideas

runs.notes: Attack day. Four judges who had never seen the work (a fixed-income portfolio manager, a finance professor, a capital-campaign director, a plain reader), each scored only on Wharton's guide, made 144 attacks on the plan, the store's top 50, the aha register and the syntheses; every attack has Keel's answer and 22 decisions in `research/ATTACKS.md`, and 50 store rows were demoted or reworded. Twelve research workers on the investing ideas under the plan (cards Q188-Q199: Tobin, Roy, volatility drag, Black and Tepper, barbell and ladder, margin of safety, Hamilton, preferred habitat, safe assets, deep risk, survivorship, ergodicity), 378 rows, every row rated the same morning by nine raters; four second-wave workers on the attacks (Q200 pledges that count, Q201 who pays overruns, Q202 what funders check, Q207 the 2022 gilt crisis and SVB at source), 114 rows; seven more second-wave cards (Q203-Q206, Q208-Q210) stopped at the weekly limit and resume. Analysis: NUMBERS section 9's open items, the bond judge's arithmetic (the test keeps each payment's own coupons; the WInS book reconciled), a picture of where the money goes (12 of version 61's 26 questions answered alone), the fact sheet checked (33 problems) and rebuilt as version 3. Voice round 11: six blind readers, three writers; store 9,603 ideas

Days 14 and 15 together, paced at about half last week's volume while the pacing decision waits (the weekly limit resets Sun 29 Nov 09:00). Structure from the material: the argument tree (ARGUMENT_TREE.md: governing thought, seven branches, ten ahas re-slotted, one outside parallel per part, forty goldmine nuggets placed), the lead decided (the deletion test), SKELETON and CASE_MAP section D refined, Caplet's one-page shape (caplet/FR_SHAPE_2026-11-22.md). Third research round aimed at the attacks: seven second-wave cards (Q203-Q206, Q208-Q210), every row rated the same day by three raters (DV, DW, DX; 331 rows). Voice round 13 (two long pieces, six blind readers, per paragraph and from memory) and round 12 (two writers, four blind readers, the Why column); fact sheet versions 4 and 5. Store 9,820.

Paced at about half last week's volume while the pacing decision waits. Seven research workers, each reading primary sources whole: four read the report's placed outside parallels at source (cards Q211 the California State Lottery Commission's investment policy, Q212 the RBA's forward guidance, Q213 pledges counted and Lehman's pledge to Spelman, Q214 the 2022 gilt crisis) and three took Sat 21's themes (Q215 graphic memoirists' income, Q216 what residencies do, Q217 the Taiwan dollar 1985-1992); about 60 sources read in full and about 225 at source; 230 rows. Analysis: the syntheses card Q218 (20 built, 14 kept), the second-way check of 66 tree figures (four fixed), and three raters (DY, DZ, EA) rating every new row the same evening, with overrides on older rows the cards corrected. Readers: two fresh writers, four blind readers and two blind scorers for voice round 14 (the continuing exercise restored "we"; the cold retelling caught 2 of Caplet's 5 failed lines), and three cold readers for aha test 9 (owned against signed kept 3d's slot, 3.3 / 3.7). Claims kept 6, changed 7, killed 2. Store 10,064.

Sources and exhibits, with judging panel 5. Research: five cards on assumptions and watching (Q219 trial stopping rules, Q220 Everest's turnaround times, Q221 Citicorp, Q222 how many signals one watcher can follow, Q223 kill criteria and tripwires), 172 rows, every row rated the same morning by three raters (store 10,236), and four sources checkers who opened every work the report will cite at source (201 checks, 173 ready to cite in APA 7, research/WORKS_CITED_DRAFT.md). Analysis: the numbers owner (NUMBERS 8x: the Taiwan dollar 1986-88 from the currency alone, register lines for the second-way figures), the exhibits builder (seven exhibits rebuilt to the argument tree; the dots replace Table 2), three raters, a blind depth scorer and two voice writers. Readers: panel 5's three blind judges (top 50 likely, top 10 not yet; density, 3d's range and 3f's length fixed in the tree the same morning), three voice readers (round 15: depth came from the fact sheet, now version 7) and two fresh exhibit readers.

The Team Reflection's three moments. Six research workers, each reading primary sources at source (cards Q224 testing your own plan: Feynman, Popper, Mayo; Q225 order errors and the Swiss cheese model: Mizuho 2005, Knight 2012, Reason; Q226 how investors write about their mistakes; Q227 adversarial collaboration and the copout, a level deeper; Q228 judging by process: Duke, Tetlock, Baron and Hershey; Q229 satisficing and the half kept), about 60 sources, 189 rows, every row rated the same evening (store 10,425). Readers: six blind readers for voice round 16 (the signature turn 0 of 3 first time; 3d plain, final). Claims kept 4, changed 15, killed 2.

The co-sponsor part, settled in notes (research/COSPONSOR_NOTES.md). The conceit. Readers: three blind readers for voice round 18 (the repaired words for co-sponsors: 86% followed, all booked $115,000, every reader asked what stands behind the make-up promise). Claims kept 12, changed 9, killed 4.

Final ranking and section notes. Six research workers, each reading primary sources at source: second readings of the outside facts the report leans on hardest (cards Q242 the lottery's rule, Leibowitz and Redington; Q243 the RBA and the 2022 gilt crisis; Q244 Lehman and Spelman, CASE, FAS 116, Oman, GIW) and the week's best ideas a level deeper (Q245 the order of purchase against waterfalls; Q246 a share slump then a cost burst; Q247 where judgement pays), about 120 sources, 227 rows, every row rated the same morning by raters EP, EQ and ER. The store's final judgement: four raters (EL-EO) judged the 828 rows never judged, so every one of 11,103 ideas has a status and a reason, and all 44 gold nuggets are placed or merged. Readers: three blind readers for voice round 19 (3a and 3e) and eleven reviewers rehearsing the writing session's review loop on the submitted IPS with five planted faults (every fault caught by at least four).
